title: Count log levels
hints: Start with `counts = {"ERROR": 0, "WARN": 0, "INFO": 0}` so the keys exist and keep their order even when a level never appears.
Loop `for line in f:` and find the first '[' with str.partition; the text up to the next ']' is the level token.
Map WARNING to WARN with a small dict, then only increment if the token is a key of counts.
